softwareProjects.title: AI Analytics Dashboard
softwareProjects.description: A cutting-edge data visualization platform that leverages Gemini AI to provide predictive insights and real-time behavioral analysis for enterprise users.

caseStudyDetails.challenge: Enterprise teams needed actionable real-time telemetry analytics without spending hours parsing raw database logs.
caseStudyDetails.solution: Engineered a streaming D3.js visual dashboard backed by Gemini AI, auto-generating natural language summaries and predictive risk trends.
caseStudyDetails.impact: Reduced data analysis turnaround by 75% for enterprise product teams.

softwareProjects.title: NDAJE Green E-commerce Platform
softwareProjects.description: A high-performance commerce solution built with Next.js 15, featuring complex state management, instant search, and seamless Stripe payment workflows.

caseStudyDetails.challenge: Legacy shopfront suffered high cart abandonment due to slow page transitions and delayed checkout steps.
caseStudyDetails.solution: Architected a headless storefront using Next.js App Router, optimistic UI updates, and sub-second Stripe checkout session initialization.
caseStudyDetails.impact: Boosted conversion rates by 38% and achieved a 99/100 Lighthouse performance score.

softwareProjects.title: Creative Studio CMS
softwareProjects.description: A bespoke drag-and-drop content management system designed for creative agencies to manage high-fidelity visual assets and team workflows.

caseStudyDetails.challenge: Creative teams struggled with fragmented media storage, inconsistent metadata tagging, and missing role permissions.
caseStudyDetails.solution: Created an intuitive canvas-style CMS with drag-and-drop asset organization, instant live previewing, and real-time collaboration.
caseStudyDetails.impact: Streamlined agency content publishing pipelines across 12 active client brands.

softwareProjects.title: Smart Order IoT Hub
softwareProjects.description: A centralized control system for smart home devices, featuring real-time telemetry monitoring, automated routines, and voice command integration.

caseStudyDetails.challenge: Multi-device IoT setups required a unified mobile-friendly web dashboard with microsecond web-socket updates.
caseStudyDetails.solution: Built a lightweight MQTT consumer dashboard with customizable automation widgets and status alerts.
caseStudyDetails.impact: Connected 50+ smart node sensors with seamless latency under 20ms.

softwareProjects.title: Decentralized Voting System
softwareProjects.description: A secure and transparent voting platform built on blockchain technology, ensuring tamper-proof results and anonymous participation.

caseStudyDetails.challenge: Organizations lacked an open, verifiable digital voting mechanism that protected user anonymity.
caseStudyDetails.solution: Designed smart contracts with zero-knowledge verification techniques and an approachable Web3 interface.
caseStudyDetails.impact: Successfully conducted mock organizational elections with 100% audit accuracy.
